items.title: Albert Burbank Interview, 1959-03-18
items.q: That was the first school I went to, Miss Angelina Barnerys.

ctx.x: Yes. Which school did you go to, by the way? I usually forget to ask people where they went to school or anything about their childhood.

My first school was a private school, just about, just a block and a half from where I was living. Because after I was born and grew up big enough to go to school, we was living on the island between Johnson and Galvis. Was it one of the Catholic schools? Yes. That was the first school I went to, Miss Angelina Barnerys.
When was the first parade you ever saw that you can remember? Or anything like the Mardi Gras in those days, what they were like?
